confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded from a few third-party travel guides and one hotel rate sheet, which disagree (beer roughly $3.00 to $5.00 per serving, cocktails roughly $7 to $9). Restaurant meal anchors are less certain than the drink anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context, not checked against live listings. Overall confidence is medium, lower for accommodation than for food and drink.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Southern African tourist towns with USD-dominant pricing, such as Livingstone (Zambia) and other Zimbabwean resort towns. Drink prices were cross-checked against a hotel rate sheet, which likely sits above local street-level prices.
